select T0.TRADE_ID as tradeId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr,
T0.ORDER_TYPE as type, DATE_FORMAT(T0.SETTLE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as settleDat, T0.SETTLE_AMT as settleAmt, T0.CCY as ccyCode, T0.CCY as ccy, (case when T0.PS = '01' then T4.ACCT_NAME else T5.ACCT_NAME end) AS myAcctName, (case when T0.PS = '01' then T0.MY_ACCT_NO else end) AS myAcctNo, (case when T0.PS = '01' then T5.ACCT_NAME else T4.ACCT_NAME end) AS counterAcctName, (case when T0.PS = '01' then T0.COUNTER_ACCT_NO else T0.MY_ACCT_NO end) AS counterAcctNo, T0.SETTLE_STATUS AS status from STL_ORDERS T0 left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 on T0.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on ( deal.BUSI_NO = T1.TRADE_ID OR deal.BUSI_NO = T0.ORDER_ID ) inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO T4 on T0.MY_ACCT_NO = T4.ACCT_NO left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO T5 on T0.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T5.ACCT_NO where T0.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and T0.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiType} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
